name: Thiruvaachakam (Tamil Shaivite hymns)
lineage: Thiruvaachakam ("Sacred Utterance") canonical Tamil Shaivite devotional poetry composed in the ninth century by Manikkavachakar, comprising 51 hymns expressing intense personal-devotional anguish and longing for Shiva. The collection forms part of the Tirumurai canonical Tamil Shaivite scriptural corpus and is integral to liturgy at the Chidambaram Nataraja Temple and the broader Tamil Shaivite temple circuit. Performance follows strict Tamil cantillation tradition transmitted through hereditary Othuvar singer lineages. The popular saying "Thiruvaachakathukku urugaar oru vaachakathukkum urugaar" ("those unmoved by Thiruvaachakam are unmoved by anything") captures the corpus's emotional power.
